cross_verification.note: Successfully fetched the official ChileAtiende/Registro Civil e Identificación (SRCeI) passport page directly: it confirms the passport document itself is valid for 10 years, but does not publish a citizen-facing photo specification (size/background/head height). This is because SRCeI captures the passport photo digitally in person at the civil registry office rather than accepting a pre-made photo, which plausibly explains why no official numeric photo spec is published. Third-party ID-photo services (visafoto, photoaid, rutificadorchile, etc.) repeatedly cite 4.5x4.5cm/white background, but per the truthfulness gate these are excluded as non-official sources, so size/background/head_height remain unverified rather than confirmed or flagged as conflicting.
